title: Pehčevo fire, August 2021
summary: EFFIS maps 5,413 ha burned in Pehčevo and dates the fire from 2021-08-02 to 2021-08-07.
Satellites recorded 645 hotspot detections inside the mapped area on 9 of the 12 days shown, the most on 2021-08-05 (218).
The windiest day in ERA5 was 2021-08-06, averaging 11 km/h from the north with gusts to 46 km/h.

context.text: On 4 August 2021 a squadron of five firefighting helicopters sent to the Pehčevo region was ordered to pull back because of extreme heat; MIA reported the fire spreading from Pehčevo toward Berovo.

selection: Archive detections (MODIS and VIIRS, algorithm type 2 static sources excluded) inside the EFFIS perimeter buffered by 1.5 km, from two days before the EFFIS fire date to one day after the last detection day of the fire's run (at most 2 empty days in between), 12 days at most 21.

weather.source: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo archive API
weather.notes: Hourly values at the ERA5 cell nearest the perimeter centroid (about 25 km grid): regional weather, not the fire's own valley. Noon = 11:00 UTC; noon rain is the 24 h total up to that hour.

sources.label: ERA5 hourly via Open-Meteo archive API
